excel_root_replacement.description: For the Mansa branch, the Excel tree is authoritative for the root and detailed branch information. Excel supplies the detailed Mansa-branch names and dates; Ama Buah (Nana Mansa) is the canonical identity for HTML Mansa, and Abena Gyampraa is the canonical identity for HTML Maa Abena. Kwaku Buafo is recorded as Ama Buah's spouse/partner, not as her parent.
